title: Tandem Affinity Immunopurification
author: Xavier Contreras
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kgrctv6

steps.title: Prepare Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare and filter-sterilize the following buffers, storing them at +4°C.

substeps.instruction: HA-IP buffer: 150 mM KCl, 20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 0.05% NP-40, 0.1% Tween, 10% glycerol, 5 mM MgCl2. Just prior to use, add 1 mM DTT, CompleteTM (50x stock), and PhosSTOP (10x stock).
Glycine buffer: 0.1M Glycine pH 2.2.
Tris buffer: 1M Tris pH 7.9.

steps.title: Prepare Flag Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 µl of Flag beads per IP.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/4 bead volume of 0.1 M Glycine pH 2.2 and mix well.
Incubate for 3 min at RT.
Add 1/2 bead volume of 1 M Tris pH 7.9 and mix well.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C and discard supernatant.
Wash beads with 1 ml of HA-IP buffer.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C, discard supernatant, and resuspend beads in HA-IP buffer.

steps.title: Perform Flag Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Bind the Flag-tagged protein from the nuclear extract.

substeps.instruction: Remove 10% of nuclear extract and store as 'input'.
Mix 1 volume of nuclear extract with 2 volumes of HA-IP buffer and the prepared Flag beads.
Rotate tubes on a rotating wheel for 4 h at 4°C.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C.
Transfer supernatant ('Flag flowthrough') to cold tubes, snap freeze in liquid N2, and store at -20°C (short term) or -80°C (long term).

Wash Flag beads 5 times: add 1 ml HA-IP buffer, rotate to mix, centrifuge 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C, and discard supernatant. For the final wash, spin briefly up to 10k rpm to ensure beads are well pelleted.

steps.title: Elute Flag-Tagged Protein
steps.instruction: Competitively elute the protein using Flag peptide.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Flag elution buffer by diluting Flag peptide to 200 ng/µl final concentration in HA-IP buffer.

First Elution (E1): Add at least 100 µl of Flag elution buffer to beads in 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes; incubate for 1 h at 4°C on a rotating wheel. Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C and transfer supernatant to a cold tube ('E1 Flag elution').

Second Elution (E2): Add at least 50 µl of Flag elution buffer to beads in 500 µl tubes; incubate for 1 h at 4°C on a rotating wheel. Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C and pool supernatant ('E2 Flag elution') with E1.

steps.title: Prepare HA Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare 40 µl of HA beads following the same procedure used for Flag beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 400 µl of HA-IP buffer per IP sample.
Note: If Flag beads were not fully removed during the previous step, add 1-2 µl of Flag peptide to prevent interference.

steps.title: Perform HA Immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Bind the HA-tagged protein from the pooled Flag elutions.

substeps.instruction: Mix pooled Flag elutions with prepared HA beads and rotate on a rotating wheel for 2 h at 4°C.
Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at +4°C.
Transfer supernatant to a cold tube ('HA flowthrough').
Wash HA beads 5 times: add 1 ml HA-IP buffer, rotate to mix, centrifuge 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C, and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Elute HA-Tagged Protein
steps.instruction: Competitively elute the protein using HA peptide.

substeps.instruction: Prepare HA elution buffer by diluting HA peptide to 400 ng/µl final concentration in HA-IP buffer.

First Elution (E1): Add 100 µl of HA elution buffer to beads in 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes; incubate for 1 h at 4°C on a rotating wheel. Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C and transfer supernatant to a cold tube ('E1 HA elution').

Second Elution (E2): Add 50 µl of HA elution buffer to beads in 500 µl tubes; incubate for 1 h at 4°C on a rotating wheel. Centrifuge for 3 min at 3000 rpm at 4°C and pool supernatant ('E2 HA elution') with E1.

steps.title: Clear Elution via Pierce Column
steps.instruction: Final purification of the pooled HA elutions using a Pierce column.

substeps.instruction: Rinse Pierce column with 400 µl of HA-IP buffer and centrifuge at 7000 rpm for 3 min at 4°C; discard flowthrough.
Load pooled HA elutions onto the column.
Centrifuge at 7000 rpm for 3 min at 4°C and collect the flowthrough containing the purified Flag.HA-tagged protein.
